# Care32 Super Speciality Dental Clinic

Care32 Super Speciality Dental Clinic is a family-friendly dental clinic in Kukatpally, Hyderabad, located at 3rd Floor, Ard Magnum, Kukatpally.

## Contact
- WhatsApp and primary phone: +91 82 82 82 1409
- Alternate phone: +91 82 82 82 1479

## Clinic Hours
- Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM-2:00 PM and 5:30 PM-8:00 PM
- Sunday: 10:30 AM-12:30 PM
- Closed Monday to Saturday from 2:00 PM-5:30 PM and Sunday after 12:30 PM

## Doctors
- Dr. Samatha, BDS - Cosmetic Dental Surgeon, 20+ years of experience. Specialist in kids dentistry, tooth extractions, root canal, dental implants, smile makeovers and prosthodontic rehabilitation.
- Dr. Sandeep, BDS, MDS - Orthodontics, 20+ years of experience. Expert in metal braces, ceramic braces and clear aligner therapy.

## Services And Technology
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Kids dentistry
- Tooth extractions
- Root canal treatment
- Dental implants
- Smile makeovers
- Prosthodontic rehabilitation
- Metal braces, ceramic braces and clear aligners
- Digital X-rays
- CAD/CAM computer-designed milled zirconia crowns
- Laser treatment tools
- Hospital-grade sterilisation with sterilized instruments, single-use disposables and strict cross-infection control protocols
- Other consultants with 20+ years of experience in aligners, implants, pediatrics, root canal treatment and gum surgery
